g.text: ANGER: LEAP
Listen · Empathise ·
Agree · Partner!
GRIEF: TASKS
accept · feel · adjust
· relocate · live!
COMPLAINT: HEAR
Hear · Empathise ·
Act · Record!
DENIAL: DON'T BULLDOZE
"take time — I'll
return + revisit"
SORRY: CANDOUR
honest + prompt +
fix + learn!
LEAP (anger!): Listen fully (don't interrupt rage!) · Empathise ("waiting 6 hours IS
infuriating…") · Agree where true ("you're right — this failed…") · Partner ("let's fix the
next step together…"). Safety: exit available, help near, threats = security + report.
ANGER RULES: never match volume · never defend/judge · name the feeling · offer choices ·
pause if unsafe ("I'll return with my senior in 10 min"). Document facts + quotes.
GRIEF (Worden's TASKS, not stages!): accept reality · feel the pain · adjust to roles ·
relocate bond + live on. Kübler-Ross (denial/anger/bargaining/depression/acceptance) =
FLUID waves, never stairs! Support: presence + rituals + practical help + follow-up weeks
later (grief peaks AFTER funerals!). Complicated grief → refer.
DENIAL: protective shock-absorber — "take your time; the treatment waits; I'll return"
+ revisit + drip-feed facts. Bulldozing ("accept it!") breaks trust, not denial.
HEAR (complaints!): Hear fully (write AS they speak!) · Empathise ("I'd be upset too…")
· Act (fix what's fixable NOW + escalate rest + deadlines!) · Record (incident + response
+ follow-up!). Complaints are FREE audits — thank them.
CANDOUR: errors disclosed honestly + promptly ("what happened, why, what we do now, how
we prevent it") + sincere sorry + documented. Cover-ups end careers (INF M03!).
LINKS: M02 hold-space · PRO-I M6 accountability · GER M6 loss · INF incidents.
MANTRA: "leap with anger, walk with grief, thank complaints, own errors."
